experiment_plans.feasibility_notes: No GPU needed, but the parameter sweep is large enough to warrant a batch job.
experiment_plans.objective: Test whether ensemble size has diminishing returns for tabular classification accuracy.

independent: number of estimators in the ensemble

experiment_plans.design: Parameter sweep over ensemble sizes, five seeds each, on one fixed dataset.

data_requirements.description: A moderately sized synthetic tabular classification dataset with informative and noise features.
preprocessing_steps: Generate the dataset once with a fixed seed
Hold out a fixed test split reused across all runs

evaluation.baseline: A single decision stump on the same split.
evaluation.success_criteria: Accuracy gains fall below 0.005 per doubling beyond some ensemble size, and that size is identified.

implementation_steps.description: Sweep ensemble sizes across five seeds each
Record accuracy and fit time per configuration
Identify the point of diminishing returns

risks: The sweep may be dominated by seed variance rather than ensemble size.

priority_order.justification: the only plan in this benchmark case
